meta.name: Generate LMS completion certificates with Groq, PDFShift, Gmail and Slack

name: AI Course Completion Certificate Generation & Delivery System

parameters.content:
## ⚠️ Error Handler
Catches any failure in the workflow and posts a Slack alert. Wire the error output of critical nodes here to prevent silent failures going unnoticed.

## 🎓 AI Certificate Generator — LMS Course Completion Automation

### How it works
When a student completes a course in your LMS, a webhook fires with their score and course ID. The workflow checks their score against a pass threshold stored in Google Sheets, and if they pass, calls Groq's free Llama API to write a personalised certificate body. The certificate is rendered as styled HTML, converted to a PDF via PDFShift, logged to an issued certificates registry, and emailed to the student — all within seconds. Failed attempts exit cleanly without generating a certificate.

### Setup steps
1. **Webhook** — Point your LMS webhook to the `Receive Course Completion Event` node URL. Use the pinned test payload to verify the connection.
2. **Google Sheets** — Connect OAuth2. Replace `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID` in both sheet nodes. Create two tabs: `CourseThresholds` (course_id, course_title, pass_score, certificate_template) and `IssuedCertificates` (cert_id, student_name, student_email, course_name, score, completion_date, issued_at, status).
3. **Groq AI** — Sign up free at console.groq.com, create an API key, and add it as an n8n credential. Replace the Authorization header value.
4. **PDFShift** — Create an account at pdfshift.io, copy your API key, and replace the `X-API-Key` header. Use `"sandbox": true` in the body while testing.
5. **Gmail** — Connect OAuth2. Update the `sendTo` field to use `$json.studentEmail` dynamically.
6. **Slack** — Connect your workspace. Update the channel ID in the error alert node.
7. Test end-to-end using the pinned webhook payload.

## 📥 Trigger & Pass Validation
Receives the LMS webhook payload, looks up the course pass threshold from Google Sheets, and gates the flow. Students who meet the score proceed to certificate generation; those who don't exit here.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – AI Text & Certificate Build

parameters.content:
## 🤖 AI Text Generation & Certificate Build
Groq's free Llama model writes a warm, personalised 2–3 sentence certificate body based on the student's name, score, course, and completion date. The result is combined with student data into a fully styled HTML certificate ready for PDF conversion.

## 📄 PDF Conversion, Logging & Delivery
PDFShift converts the HTML certificate to a print-quality A4 PDF in a single API call. The certificate record is logged to the IssuedCertificates sheet for verification, then emailed to the student with the PDF attached.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use OAuth2 for Gmail and Google Sheets. Store Groq and PDFShift API keys via n8n credentials manager — never paste them directly into node headers. Replace all sample emails, IDs, and channel values before publishing.
